157:Asian Law College is a premier law college in Delhi NCR, offering a three-year undergraduate LL.B. program designed to spread legal knowledge among professionals from diverse disciplines across society. The program aims to impart quality legal education to students from varied academic backgrounds, equipping them to perform the multifaceted roles of a legal professional extending well beyond the traditional domain of litigation.
